stats.quantile: linear interpolation between order statistics (Hyndman-Fan type 7)
stats.bootstrap: cluster bootstrap: resample sessions with replacement, percentile interval
stats.test: two-sided, normal approximation with tie and continuity correction

header.statement: Pre/post compares the adoption bundle, not ghx alone: ghx, its PreToolUse hook, the CLAUDE.md block and the no-sleep memory arrived together. The data are observational: sessions differ in their work, model mix and share of subagents, so a difference here is an association, not an effect of ghx.

dev_projects.note: ghx development (this repo, spike directories): reported as bucket dogfood-dev, never compared

metrics.description: Prompts a person typed (findings §1.4) inside the unit. 0 for episodes by construction (a prompt closes one).
metrics.formula: count of main-thread turns with is_human whose start lies inside the unit (session: all of them)

metrics.description: API calls that emitted one of the unit's tool calls (GitHub calls and glue). Findings §4.2's 'Round trips' column is gh_round_trips, which counts only calls emitting a GitHub call. Since 1.1.0, a wait keeps the status reads and foreground waits on its target right after its wake, and the first other GitHub call after a wake opens an episode flagged after-wake and ends the one open before the wait.
metrics.formula: unique message.id over the unit's tool calls (session: all API calls)

metrics.description: GitHub calls plus glue calls inside the unit (session: every tool call).
metrics.formula: count of tool_use ids in the unit

metrics.description: API calls that emitted at least one GitHub tool call.
metrics.formula: unique message.id over GitHub tool calls

metrics.description: API calls charged to the unit (see Span). For a session, the sum over its GitHub units. Since 1.1.0, a wait keeps the status reads and foreground waits on its target right after its wake, and the first other GitHub call after a wake opens an episode flagged after-wake and ends the one open before the wait.
metrics.formula: len(span)

metrics.description: Glue tool calls: work done on GitHub output that is not itself a gh/ghx call. The prototype counted API calls (span_calls − linked − 1); units here carry glue explicitly, so this counts glue tool calls.
metrics.formula: tool_calls − gh_tool_calls

metrics.description: GitHub tool calls. Since 1.1.0, a wait keeps the status reads and foreground waits on its target right after its wake, and the first other GitHub call after a wake opens an episode flagged after-wake and ends the one open before the wait.
metrics.formula: count of Bash/Monitor calls running gh or ghx

metrics.description: gh/ghx invocations in the command texts (a compound command can hold several).
metrics.formula: sum of n_invocations over GitHub calls

metrics.description: Distinct normalised command signatures.
metrics.formula: unique signatures; signature = "<cli> <subcommand>" per invocation joined by " ; "

metrics.description: GitHub calls that repeat an earlier signature.
metrics.formula: gh_tool_calls − distinct_cmds

metrics.description: A GitHub call with the same signature as the previous one, which failed.
metrics.formula: consecutive equal signatures where the first has error_kind ≠ null

metrics.description: Output tokens over the span (thinking included). Subagent values are recovered (M1 out_src); the recovery has a +14% aggregate bias.
metrics.formula: sum output_tokens over span

metrics.description: Output tokens spent writing GitHub calls: each emitting call’s output split across its tool calls by input size.
metrics.formula: sum over GitHub-emitting calls of output_tokens × (GitHub tool input chars / all tool input chars)

metrics.description: Characters of GitHub results and follow-up reads the model saw (tool_result.content).
metrics.formula: sum result_chars over GitHub calls and read glue

metrics.description: Context added by GitHub results and follow-up reads (R² 0.93–0.96 against measured Δcontext).
metrics.formula: sum over GitHub calls and read glue of result_chars / 2.2 + 70

metrics.description: Measured Δcontext for GitHub calls where it is clean; validation only (about half of calls qualify). Null when no call qualifies.
metrics.formula: sum over GitHub calls whose emitting call has one tool_use and whose next call is the next index of ctx(next) − ctx(call) − output_tokens(call)

metrics.description: Glue calls that read GitHub output (redirect targets, logPath files, background output files).
metrics.formula: count of read glue

metrics.description: Cache-read tokens over the span. Dominated by session context; do not compare raw across arms.
metrics.formula: sum cache_read over span

metrics.description: Cache-write tokens (5m + 1h) over the span.
metrics.formula: sum cache_creation over span

metrics.description: Span calls that rewrote most of their context (an idle gap past the cache lifetime: 5m subagent, 1h main).
metrics.formula: count of span calls with context > 5000 and cache_creation / context > 0.5

metrics.description: Priced usage over the span, including 5m/1h cache writes and advisor iterations. Confounded by context size. Caveats (M1): subagent advisor cost is invisible in transcripts; opus is 6–20% under cost-state in subagent-heavy sessions (unrecorded side calls). Since 1.1.0, a wait keeps the status reads and foreground waits on its target right after its wake, and the first other GitHub call after a wake opens an episode flagged after-wake and ends the one open before the wait.
metrics.formula: sum cost_usd over span

metrics.description: Headline dollar figure (findings §2): keeps the unit’s own context growth and cache rewrites but replaces the session’s base context with 50k. Same caveats as cost. Since 1.1.0, a wait keeps the status reads and foreground waits on its target right after its wake, and the first other GitHub call after a wake opens an episode flagged after-wake and ends the one open before the wait.
metrics.formula: sum over span of [output + advisor cost + input cost × max(0, ctx − C0 + 50000) / ctx], C0 = context of the first span call, input cost = cost − output − advisor

metrics.description: Re-reading GitHub results on later calls, capped at 50 calls. Depends on unrelated later work; secondary.
metrics.formula: sum over GitHub calls and read glue of (result tokens + allocated emitting output) × min(calls until compaction or end of file, 50) × cache-read price

metrics.description: Elapsed time from the unit’s first call to its last event. Includes CI’s own duration: report, never optimise.
metrics.formula: end_ts − start_ts

metrics.description: Time the agent waited on foreground GitHub calls.
metrics.formula: sum over foreground GitHub calls of result_ts − call_ts

metrics.description: GitHub calls that failed: a non-zero exit, a ghx error body (even behind a pipe), a hook block or a denial. ghx exits 10, 11 and 15 are outcomes, not errors.
metrics.formula: count of GitHub calls with error_kind ≠ null

metrics.description: GitHub calls refused by ghx policy, a hook, the permission system or the harness.
metrics.formula: count of GitHub calls with refusal ≠ null

metrics.description: GitHub commands piped into another command.
metrics.formula: count of GitHub calls with glue.pipe

metrics.description: GitHub commands using --jq, -q or | jq.
metrics.formula: count of GitHub calls with glue.jq

metrics.description: GitHub commands with a sleep or a while/until loop (polling).
metrics.formula: count of GitHub calls with glue.sleep or glue.loop

metrics.description: GitHub commands using --watch or run watch.
metrics.formula: count of GitHub calls with glue.watch

metrics.description: GitHub Bash calls that ran in the background.
metrics.formula: count of GitHub Bash calls with run_in_background or a background task id

metrics.description: Monitor tool calls whose script runs gh or ghx.
metrics.formula: count of GitHub Monitor calls

metrics.description: Task notifications for the unit’s background GitHub calls and Monitors (each counted once: rule 6).
metrics.formula: sum notif_count over background GitHub calls

metrics.description: Distinct API calls that a notification of the unit started or fed (a notification arriving mid-turn and one starting a turn both make the next call read it). Reported per wait and per lifecycle.
metrics.formula: unique (file, call index) of the call after each notification of the unit

metrics.description: CI rounds: distinct head SHAs seen on the PR (git push boundaries when no SHA is visible: flag sha-fallback).
metrics.formula: pr_cycle: 1; pr_lifecycle: number of its cycles

metrics.description: Episodes and waits the unit is built from.
metrics.formula: len(children)

metrics.description: API calls in the session (main + subagents).
metrics.formula: unique message.id

metrics.description: GitHub work’s share of the session’s API calls.
metrics.formula: span_calls (union over episodes and waits) / api_calls

metrics.description: GitHub work’s share of the session’s cost.
metrics.formula: cost (union of episode and wait spans) / session cost
